library(knitr)
library(tools)

`%||%` <- function(x, y) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x)) || !nzchar(as.character(x[[1]]))) y else x
}

normalize_slash <- function(path) {
  gsub("\\\\", "/", path)
}

input_dir <- normalizePath(params$input_dir, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
metadata_dir <- file.path(input_dir, "metadata")
single_root <- file.path(input_dir, "single")
compare_root <- file.path(input_dir, "compare")
logs_root <- file.path(input_dir, "logs")

read_manifest <- function(path, cols, sep = ",") {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    out <- as.data.frame(setNames(replicate(length(cols), character(0), simplify = FALSE), cols))
    return(out)
  }
  df <- read.table(
    path,
    sep = sep,
    header = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE,
    quote = "\"",
    comment.char = ""
  )
  missing <- setdiff(cols, names(df))
  for (col in missing) df[[col]] <- character(nrow(df))
  df[, cols, drop = FALSE]
}

sample_manifest <- read_manifest(
  file.path(metadata_dir, "sample_manifest.csv"),
  c("sample", "input", "subset_col", "subset_group")
)

compare_manifest <- read_manifest(
  file.path(metadata_dir, "compare_manifest.csv"),
  c("sample1", "sample2", "outdir")
)

failed_tasks <- read_manifest(
  file.path(logs_root, "failed_tasks.tsv"),
  c("task_type", "name", "log_file"),
  sep = "\t"
)

sample_outdir <- function(sample) {
  normalize_slash(file.path(single_root, sample))
}

compare_title <- function(row) {
  sprintf("%s_VS_%s", row$sample1, row$sample2)
}

compare_outdir <- function(row) {
  outdir <- row$outdir %||% ""
  if (nzchar(outdir)) return(normalize_slash(outdir))
  normalize_slash(file.path(compare_root, compare_title(row)))
}

find_existing <- function(paths) {
  paths[file.exists(paths)]
}

first_existing <- function(paths) {
  hit <- find_existing(paths)
  if (length(hit) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  normalize_slash(hit[[1]])
}

find_png <- function(dir_path, pattern = "\\.png$") {
  if (!dir.exists(dir_path)) return(character(0))
  normalize_slash(list.files(dir_path, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE))
}

find_any_file <- function(paths) {
  hit <- find_existing(paths)
  if (length(hit) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  normalize_slash(hit[[1]])
}

trim_output_path <- function(path) {
  if (is.na(path) || !nzchar(path)) return(NA_character_)
  path <- normalize_slash(path)
  parts <- strsplit(path, "/", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  lower_parts <- tolower(parts)

  idx <- which(lower_parts == "output")
  if (length(idx) == 0) idx <- grep("output", lower_parts)
  if (length(idx) == 0) {
    root_name <- basename(input_dir)
    idx <- match(root_name, parts)
  } else {
    idx <- idx[[1]]
  }

  if (is.na(idx) || idx < 1) return(path)
  paste(parts[idx:length(parts)], collapse = "/")
}

render_path <- function(path) {
  if (is.na(path) || !nzchar(path)) return("<code>未检测到对应文件</code>")
  sprintf("<code>%s</code>", trim_output_path(path))
}

render_note <- function(text) {
  sprintf("<div class='report-note'>%s</div>", text)
}

render_table <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(render_note("当前模块暂无可展示信息。"))
  kable(df, format = "html", table.attr = "class='table table-report'")
}

render_image_card <- function(path, title, desc = NULL) {
  if (is.na(path) || !file.exists(path)) {
    return(render_note(sprintf("未检测到“%s”对应图片，已跳过该示例。", title)))
  }

  desc_html <- if (is.null(desc) || !nzchar(desc)) "" else sprintf("<p>%s</p>", desc)
  sprintf(
    paste0(
      "<div class='img-card'>",
      "<div class='img-card-header'><div class='img-card-title'>%s</div></div>",
      "<div class='img-card-body'>",
      "%s",
      "<img src='%s' />",
      "</div>",
      "</div>"
    ),
    title,
    desc_html,
    path
  )
}

read_preview_table <- function(path, n = 5) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(data.frame())
  ext <- tolower(file_ext(path))
  out <- tryCatch({
    if (ext == "csv") {
      read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
    } else if (ext %in% c("txt", "tsv")) {
      read.table(path, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
    } else {
      data.frame()
    }
  }, error = function(e) data.frame())

  if (nrow(out) == 0) return(out)
  head(out, n)
}

list_ordered_entries <- function(path) {
  if (!dir.exists(path)) return(character(0))
  entries <- list.files(path, full.names = TRUE, no.. = TRUE)
  entries[order(!dir.exists(entries), tolower(basename(entries)))]
}

build_subtree_lines <- function(path, prefix = "", max_depth = 2, max_entries = 8, level = 1) {
  if (!dir.exists(path) || level > max_depth) return(character(0))

  entries <- list_ordered_entries(path)
  shown <- entries[seq_len(min(length(entries), max_entries))]
  out <- character(0)

  for (i in seq_along(shown)) {
    entry <- shown[[i]]
    is_last <- i == length(shown) && length(entries) <= max_entries
    connector <- if (is_last) "`-- " else "|-- "
    out <- c(out, paste0(prefix, connector, basename(entry)))
    if (dir.exists(entry) && level < max_depth) {
      child_prefix <- paste0(prefix, if (is_last) "    " else "|   ")
      out <- c(out, build_subtree_lines(entry, child_prefix, max_depth, max_entries, level + 1))
    }
  }

  if (length(entries) > max_entries) {
    out <- c(out, paste0(prefix, "`-- ... (", length(entries) - max_entries, " more)"))
  }

  out
}

build_focus_tree <- function(branch_name, example_name, example_dir, child_depth = 2, child_entries = 8) {
  root_label <- basename(trim_output_path(input_dir))
  branch_connector <- "`-- "
  example_prefix <- "    "
  example_connector <- "`-- "

  lines <- c(
    root_label,
    paste0(branch_connector, branch_name),
    paste0(example_prefix, example_connector, example_name)
  )

  subtree_prefix <- paste0(example_prefix, "    ")
  subtree <- build_subtree_lines(example_dir, prefix = subtree_prefix, max_depth = child_depth, max_entries = child_entries)
  paste(c(lines, subtree), collapse = "\n")
}

describe_tree_item <- function(name, context = c("single", "compare")) {
  context <- match.arg(context)

  single_map <- c(
    "single" = "单样本分析结果目录。",
    "BubblePlots" = "细胞群关系对与配体-受体关系对气泡图结果目录。",
    "Overview" = "整体细胞通讯网络总览目录。",
    "Pathways" = "通路层面的 circle、heatmap、contribution 等结果目录。",
    "SignalingGroups" = "信号通路功能或结构相似性分组结果目录。",
    "SignalingRoles" = "发送者、接收者及整体角色识别结果目录。",
    "Communication_info.csv" = "细胞通讯结果表。",
    "Communication_info.txt" = "细胞通讯结果文本表。",
    "cellchat_object.rds" = "单样本 CellChat 对象。"
  )

  compare_map <- c(
    "compare" = "多组比较分析结果目录。",
    "compareInteractions.png" = "两组间相互作用总数和强度统计图。",
    "diffInteraction_count.png" = "两组间差异相互作用数量图。",
    "diffInteraction_weight.png" = "两组间差异相互作用强度图。",
    "diffInteraction_count_heatmap.png" = "两组间差异相互作用数量热图。",
    "signalingRole_scatter.png" = "主要发送者和接收者比较结果。",
    "signalingRole_heatmap_outgoing.png" = "细胞群 outgoing 模式比较图。",
    "signalingRole_heatmap_incoming.png" = "细胞群 incoming 模式比较图。",
    "signalingRole_heatmap_all.png" = "细胞群 overall 模式比较图。",
    "DEG_Network" = "差异表达辅助识别功能失调信号的状态目录。",
    "Diff_BubblePlots" = "上下调配体-受体关系对气泡图目录。",
    "Shared_Pathways" = "共享通路比较结果目录。"
  )

  mapping <- if (context == "single") single_map else compare_map
  if (name %in% names(mapping)) return(unname(mapping[[name]]))

  if (grepl("^network_interactions_.*\\.png$", name)) return("整体细胞通讯网络图文件。")
  if (grepl("\\.bubble\\.(png|pdf)$", name)) return("细胞群关系对气泡图文件。")
  if (grepl("SignalingGroups_.*\\.png$", name)) return("信号通路相似性分组图文件。")
  if (grepl("SignalingRole_.*\\.png$", name)) return("细胞通讯角色识别图文件。")
  if (grepl("\\.(circle|heatmap|contribution)\\.png$", name)) return("通路层面可视化结果文件。")
  if (grepl("^netMappingDEG_.*\\.(csv|txt|xlsx)$", name)) return("差异表达分析结果文件。")
  if (grepl("Up-Down_Regulation\\.png$", name)) return("上下调配体-受体关系对气泡图文件。")
  if (grepl("^deg_status\\.txt$", name)) return("DEG 模块状态说明文件。")

  "该目录或文件为当前分析实际生成结果。"
}

render_focus_explanations <- function(branch_name, example_name, example_dir, context = c("single", "compare")) {
  context <- match.arg(context)
  root_label <- basename(trim_output_path(input_dir))
  entries <- list_ordered_entries(example_dir)
  names_to_describe <- c(root_label, branch_name, example_name, basename(entries))

  names_to_describe <- unique(names_to_describe)
  if (length(entries) > 8) {
    names_to_describe <- unique(c(root_label, branch_name, example_name, basename(entries[seq_len(8)])))
  }

  desc <- vapply(names_to_describe, describe_tree_item, character(1), context = context)
  desc[[1]] <- "结果文件夹根目录。"
  desc[[2]] <- if (context == "single") "单样本分析结果目录。" else "多组比较分析结果目录。"
  desc[[3]] <- if (context == "single") "当前报告示例样本目录。" else "当前报告示例比较组目录。"

  paste(
    sprintf("<p><code>%s</code>：%s</p>", names_to_describe, desc),
    collapse = "\n"
  )
}

# CellChat简介

构建细胞类型图谱是单细胞转录组数据分析的主体内容，但其仍然停留在“描述性研究”的范畴，难免让人感觉意犹未尽。想要在分子层面解释疾病发生的机制，就需要对数据进行更深入的探索。这当中，细胞通讯分析就是一个很好的方向。

细胞通讯（cell communication）是指细胞接收、处理和传递与环境和自身的信号的能力，它是每个生物体中所有细胞的基本属性。由配体-受体复合物介导的细胞-细胞通讯对于协调各种生物过程至关重要，如发育、分化和炎症。多种疾病与错误的细胞间交流有关，包括糖尿病、癌症和免疫相关疾病等。

CellChat 是一个能够从单细胞 RNA 测序（scRNA-seq）数据中定量推断和分析细胞间通讯网络的 R 包。它需要细胞的基因表达数据作为输入，并通过整合基因表达与信号配体、受体及其辅助因子之间相互作用的先验知识来建立细胞-细胞交流的概率，进而对细胞间通讯做出预测，并提供多种可视化方法。

### 细胞通讯结果

```{r results='asis'}
if (!is.null(example_sample)) {
  comm_file <- find_any_file(c(
    file.path(example_sample_dir, "Communication_info.csv"),
    file.path(example_sample_dir, "Communication_info.txt")
  ))
  comm_preview <- read_preview_table(comm_file, n = 5)

  cat("<p>CellChat 通过使用 law of mass action，将基因表达与信号配体、受体及其辅因子之间相互作用的先验知识相结合，对细胞间通信的概率进行建模。得到的通讯结果表格如下：</p>")
  cat(sprintf("<p><strong>输出结果见：</strong>%s</p>", render_path(comm_file)))
  cat("<p>各列意义如下：</p>")
  cat("<p><code>source</code>：表示信号发送细胞的类型或群组；</p>")
  cat("<p><code>target</code>：表示信号接收细胞的类型或群组；</p>")
  cat("<p><code>ligand</code>：表示由 source 细胞分泌的配体分子；</p>")
  cat("<p><code>receptor</code>：表示 target 细胞上的受体分子；</p>")
  cat("<p><code>prob</code>：表示细胞间相互作用发生的概率或置信度；</p>")
  cat("<p><code>pval</code>：表示细胞间相互作用的统计显著性；</p>")
  cat("<p><code>interaction_name</code>：表示配体-受体对名称；</p>")
  cat("<p><code>interaction_name_2</code>：表示配体-受体对名称补充信息；</p>")
  cat("<p><code>pathway_name</code>：表示相关生物学通路名称；</p>")
  cat("<p><code>annotation</code>：表示配体-受体对分类注释；</p>")
  cat("<p><code>evidence</code>：表示支持该互作的数据库或文献证据。</p>")

  if (nrow(comm_preview) > 0) {
    cat(render_table(comm_preview))
  } else {
    cat(render_note("未检测到可读取的通讯结果表。"))
  }
}
```

### 受体-配体层次网络可视化

#### 细胞间配受体关系对结果可视化

```{r results='asis'}
if (!is.null(example_sample)) {
  overview_dir <- file.path(example_sample_dir, "Overview")
  overview_img <- first_existing(c(
    file.path(overview_dir, "network_interactions_count.png"),
    file.path(overview_dir, "network_interactions_weight.png"),
    file.path(overview_dir, "network_interactions_cells.png")
  ))

  cat("<p>获得的细胞间的通讯网络图如下。左图为任意两个细胞组之间的相互作用次数网络图，右图为任意两个细胞组之间的相互作用强度网络图。不同颜色的实心圆表示不同细胞群，圆大小与该细胞群对应的细胞数成正比。</p>")
  cat(sprintf("<p><strong>输出结果见：</strong>%s</p>", render_path(overview_img)))
  cat(render_image_card(
    overview_img,
    "细胞间相互作用网络示例",
    "本报告仅展示 1 张示意图，其余同类结果可在对应输出目录中查看。"
  ))
}
```

### 利用差异表达分析识别功能失调的信号

```{r results='asis'}
if (!is.null(example_compare)) {
  deg_dir <- file.path(example_compare_dir, "DEG_Network")
  deg_file <- find_any_file(c(
    file.path(deg_dir, "netMappingDEG_UP.csv"),
    file.path(deg_dir, "netMappingDEG_DOWN.csv"),
    file.path(deg_dir, "netMappingDEG_UP.txt"),
    file.path(deg_dir, "netMappingDEG_DOWN.txt")
  ))
  deg_preview <- read_preview_table(deg_file, n = 5)
  deg_status <- file.path(deg_dir, "deg_status.txt")

  cat("<p>差异表达分析可用于辅助识别功能失调的信号轴。以下展示 1 个 DEG 结果表预览；如无结果，通常说明当前阈值下未筛到显著差异。</p>")
  cat(sprintf("<p><strong>输出结果见：</strong>%s</p>", render_path(deg_dir)))

  if (file.exists(deg_status)) {
    status_text <- paste(readLines(deg_status, warn = FALSE), collapse = "<br/>")
    cat(render_note(sprintf("<strong>DEG 模块状态：</strong><br/>%s", status_text)))
  }

  if (nrow(deg_preview) > 0) {
    cat(render_table(deg_preview))
  } else {
    cat(render_note("当前未检测到可展示的 DEG 结果表。"))
  }
}
```

# 应用场景

- 比较不同样本或处理条件下的细胞通讯重塑情况。
- 识别关键细胞群在通讯网络中的发送者、接收者或中心调控角色。
- 从信号通路与配体-受体层面筛选潜在调控轴，为后续机制验证提供候选方向。
- 结合差异表达、分组设计与下游实验结果，对重点通路进行更有针对性的解释。
